notes: Structured summary of the public ICML review form. Not a verbatim copy of the reviewer guidelines.

subdimensions.label: Soundness
subdimensions.guidance: Correctness of the theory and experiments, appropriateness of assumptions and support for each claim.

subdimensions.label: Presentation
subdimensions.guidance: Clarity of the exposition and completeness of the experimental protocol.

subdimensions.label: Contribution
subdimensions.guidance: Originality and significance relative to the strongest related work.

deskRejectRules: The submission exceeds the page limit or violates the supplementary-material rules.
The submission is not anonymized when required.
The submission is not a research paper or cannot be parsed.

template.summary: Summarize the problem, technical approach and main empirical or theoretical claims.
template.strengths: Give concrete strengths with page or section references.
template.weaknesses: Give concrete weaknesses with page or section references.
template.questions: Ask questions that could materially change the rating.
template.limitations: Discuss limitations of the method, theory, experiments and scope.

rubric.summary: The summary should distinguish the paper's actual contribution from its stated motivation.
rubric.soundness: For theory, check definitions, assumptions and proof sketches. For empirics, check baselines, controls and uncertainty.
rubric.presentation: Check whether the reader can reconstruct the method and the evaluation from the paper and appendix.
rubric.contribution: Compare against the closest cited work and ask what would change if the paper did not exist.
rubric.deskReject: Desk rejection is reserved for format, scope, anonymity and integrity issues.
